newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian Resources requotes at 11 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian Resources requotes at 11 rgt.

text.p: Malaysian Resouces Corporation Bhd opened at 11 ringgit on Thursday on being requoted after finalising a deal to acquire 19.05 percent of stockbroking firm Rashid Hussain on Wednesday.
Malaysian Resources had closed at 9.70 on October 22, when it was suspended pending the deal.
Malaysian Resources (MRCB) will buy 66.127 million Rashid shares at 15.80 ringgit each to be paid for by the issue of 130.6 million new shares in MRCB at 8.00 ringgit per share.
MRCB said it had already acquired 3.5 million shares in Rashid Hussain from the open market for 52.8 million ringgit in cash, or 15 ringgit per share.
MRCB, a diversified conglomerate, will eventually hold a 20.06 percent stake in Rashid Hussain.
Rashid Hussain is a property and financial group which controls one of Malaysia's top five commercial banks and the country's largest institutional stock brokerage.
